items.exampleEn: Everyone was sympathetic when she lost her dog.
items.exampleZh: 她的狗走失時，大家都很同情她。

items.exampleEn: My coach has no mercy during training; we run until we drop.
items.exampleZh: 我的教練練習時毫不留情，我們要跑到累倒為止。

items.exampleEn: My little brother tortures me by singing the same song all day.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟整天唱同一首歌來折磨我。

items.exampleEn: After losing the game, the team wanted revenge in the next match.
items.exampleZh: 輸掉這場比賽後，球隊想在下一場報仇。

items.exampleEn: She broke her vow and told everyone the secret.
items.exampleZh: 她違背了誓言，把祕密告訴了所有人。

items.exampleEn: The furious customer demanded to see the manager.
items.exampleZh: 那位怒氣沖沖的客人要求見經理。

items.exampleEn: She gave up her free time for a noble cause: teaching kids to read.
items.exampleZh: 她為了一個崇高的目標放棄空閒時間：教孩子讀書。

items.exampleEn: It takes courage to defy your friends when they are doing something wrong.
items.exampleZh: 當朋友在做錯的事時，要違抗他們的意思需要勇氣。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher was furious because nobody had done the homework.
items.sentenceZh: 老師氣壞了，因為沒有人寫功課。

items.audioEn: Please don't torture yourself about one small mistake; everyone makes them.
items.audioZh: 別為了一個小錯折磨自己，每個人都會犯錯。
options: Don't worry about one small mistake
Tell the boss about the mistake

items.sentenceEn: Most viewers felt sympathetic toward the poor family in the film.
items.sentenceZh: 大多數觀眾都很同情電影裡那個窮苦的家庭。

items.sentenceEn: In the movie, the hero refuses to take revenge.
items.sentenceZh: 在電影裡，主角拒絕報仇。

items.stemEn: It is a ____ idea, but I don't think we have enough money for it.
items.stemZh: 這是個崇高的想法，但我覺得我們的錢不夠。

items.stemEn: After breaking his mother's favorite vase, the boy begged for ____.
items.stemZh: 打破媽媽最愛的花瓶後，男孩苦苦求饒。

items.passageEn: Last night I watched an old adventure film about a noble prince. When a cruel king takes his land, the prince is furious and makes a vow to get it back. His friends expect him to seek revenge, but the story is more interesting than that. The prince defies the king in public, yet he refuses to fight. Later, when the king loses everything, the prince shows him mercy and gives him a home. The film is a little long, and my wife joked that sitting through three hours was torture. Still, I felt genuinely sympathetic toward every character.
items.passageZh: 昨晚我看了一部老冒險片，講的是一位高尚的王子。殘暴的國王奪走他的土地時，王子怒不可遏，發誓要把土地奪回來。朋友們以為他會報仇，但故事比這有趣得多。王子在眾人面前違抗國王，卻拒絕動武。後來國王失去一切時，王子對他寬大為懷，還給了他一個家。這部電影有點長，我太太開玩笑說坐三個小時簡直是折磨。不過，我真心同情片中的每個角色。

options: 偷偷離開國家，再也不回來
立刻帶兵攻打他，奪回土地
公開違抗他，卻拒絕動武

questions.questionZh: 作者的太太怎麼評論這部電影？
options: 這是她這幾年看過最好的電影
演員們都很年輕又好看

items.promptZh: 他們在婚禮上許下了誓言。
referenceEn: They made their vows at the wedding.
They said their vows during the wedding.
rubricZh: vow 表示「誓言」（例如 make a vow、say their vows 等）
過去式或現在完成式都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 defy 造一個句子，說說某人違抗規定或別人期待的事。
referenceEn: My grandmother defied her parents and went to university.
As a teenager, I sometimes defied my parents' rules about coming home early.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 defy（例如 defy one's parents、defy the rules）
